title: PowerDirector - Video Editor
summary: Movie maker & video editing app with AI effects and green screen
description:
With over 150 million downloads and counting, PowerDirector is the Google Editor's Choice AI video editor that turns photos, clips, and text prompts into scroll-stopping videos optimized for TikTok, Reels and Shorts — in minutes, on your phone.

🎬  EASY VIDEO EDITING
■ Trim, cut, and crop — get straight to the good stuff
■ Add music and set the vibe
■ Speed up, slow down, make it yours
■ Background Removal — clean shot, no effort
■ Hundreds of transitions and effects for every mood
■ Text, stickers, and animated titles that pop
■ Edit and export clips in up to 4K resolution

--------------------------------------------------------------------

🤖  CREATE WITH AI
■ AI Video Edit by Chat — just say it. AI does the rest.
■ AI Text-to-Video — words in, viral video out
■ AI Image-to-Video — one photo, full cinematic motion
■ Cinematic Reel Creator — one photo, one tap, film-like video
■ AI Character Motion Swap — drop yourself into any scene, instantly
■ AI Storytelling — script it, narrate it, share it (multi-language)
■ AI Anime & AI Art — turn real footage into anime magic
■ AI Auto Edit — one tap to a beat-perfect, share-ready edit
■ AI Video Enhancer — blurry in, crisp HD out
■ AI Super Slow Motion — every frame, buttery smooth
■ Body Effect with Body Tracking — move like the trend

--------------------------------------------------------------------

🎛️ PROFESSIONAL EDITING TOOLS
■ Multi-track timeline — keyframes, chroma key, masks and blend modes
■ Green screen editing — put yourself anywhere
■ Video stabilizer — shaky? not anymore
■ Record and add voiceovers — your voice, your story

--------------------------------------------------------------------

🎵 MUSIC & SOUND EFFECTS
■ Thousands of tracks and sound effects — find your music in seconds
■ AI Voice Changer & Speech Enhancement — sound like a pro, instantly
■ AI Sound Effect Search — type a vibe, get the perfect sound

--------------------------------------------------------------------

👑 PREMIUM BENEFITS
■ Getty-powered stock — unlimited music, footage & images, cleared for commercial use
■ Auto Captions — subtitles that keep up with you
■ Cloud projects — start on your phone, finish anywhere
■ Exclusive filters, titles, transitions and effects
■ Ad-free, zero distractions
